create_LatentConsistencyModelPipeline: create a LatentConsistencyModelPipeline for fast text-to-image generation with LCM distillation
run_LatentConsistencyModelPipeline_call: run the LatentConsistencyModelPipeline __call__ method to generate images from text prompts in few steps
build_LCMScheduler: build an LCMScheduler with configurable beta schedule and timestep spacing for latent consistency sampling
test_LCMScheduler_step: test the LCMScheduler step method to denoise latent samples and compute previous timestep samples
summarize_betas_for_alpha_bar: summarize the betas_for_alpha_bar function that creates a beta schedule discretizing an alpha_t_bar diffusion function
